g.text: Trusted catalog, explicit refusals, integer cents
Request boundary and Cart validation — CU-01 steps 1-2
[FE-01 invalid currency, time, shape or multiple Coupon codes]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Decode Product codes and quantities only.
UTC time is explicit; no hidden clock.
[FE-01 empty Cart or quantity not an integer 1..99 (Boolean excluded)]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Trusted Product resolution and total — CU-01 steps 3-4
[each CartLine until the first absent/refused Product lookup]
[FE-03 Product lookup refused invalid authoritative price or currency]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
[FE-02 any Product absent from trusted catalog]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
[FE-03 trusted Product cents invalid or currency unsupported]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
[FA-03 valid nonempty Cart with only zero-priced Products]
Coupon configuration and eligibility — CU-01 step 5
[FE-07 lookup refused malformed selected Coupon configuration]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
[FE-07 unregistered kind or invalid fixed/rate configuration]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
[FE-07 eligibility refused noninteger minimum, invalid expiry or unsupported currency]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Pure calculation and completion — CU-01 steps 5-7
[FA-01 eligible fixed Coupon — policy is FixedDiscount]
[FA-02 eligible percentage Coupon — policy is PercentageDiscount]
[AD-09 selected policy violates integer result or 0..subtotal bounds]
Terminate this quote interaction; no successful PriceQuote is created.
Calculation contract: nonnegative integer CNY subtotal.
A zero subtotal yields zero under every supported policy.
Its constructor enforces the common quote invariants.
This internal completion action introduces no ordinary operation.
All calls are synchronous; dashed arrows are replies to their original caller.
Every break is directly inside this interaction (outside loop/opt); it terminates the quote.
The line loop stops after an absent Product; optional calls return before their outer refusal break.
A refusal never reaches PriceQuote creation.
No order, payment, redemption, persistence or mutation operation exists in this collaboration.
Negative-minimum acceptance/refusal remains outside the bounded baseline; no new rule is inferred.
